“The wish you said you would grant if I defeated the Demon King, it’s to go back to the past.”
Allen makes a wish to the Goddess and returns to before all the adventures began. And he decides to live a completely different life than before.
“There is no free goodwill in my dictionary.”
◈◈◈
After a grueling life as a world-saving Hero, Allen, disillusioned by the corruption of his comrades and the ingratitude of humanity, makes a desperate wish: to relive his life from before he became a hero. Granted his wish, Allen returns to his humble beginnings with the knowledge and power of his past life, but with a crucial difference: he vows to never offer kindness without a price.
Haunted by the memories of a world ravaged by war and betrayal, Allen embarks on a second journey, this time determined to enjoy life, settle old scores, and navigate the treacherous landscape of gods, demons, and morally ambiguous humans with cynical pragmatism. He will once again face the Demon King, but on his own terms, and with a burning desire to manipulate the world around him for his own twisted amusement.

104372.synopsis:
Ruo Xiaoxi is a stunningly beautiful and adorable vampire princess. In order to maintain her daily blood supply, she’s forced to become emotionally involved with various girls.
“Can getting a meal be considered green tea behavior? Who’s the real s*umbag here?!”

…

“Now that you’re in a dress, you don’t recognize me?! Let’s see you run now!”
Click!
The locked handcuffs bound them together, and Ruo Xiaoxi’s face gradually paled.
She knew her retribution had arrived.

110260.synopsis:
When Jiang Yuman opened her eyes, she found herself transmigrated into a book as the male lead’s evil ex-wife, who was already six months pregnant.
In the original story, the original Jiang Yuman was obsessed with becoming an official’s wife. She schemed her way into marrying into the Fu family, but when the family was falsely accused and dismissed from their posts—facing exile to the countryside—she ignored their pleas and promises, had an abortion, and divorced her husband in one fell swoop.
Now, staring at her handsome husband, who looked better than future-day celebrities, and touching her six-month belly, Jiang Yuman sighed, “You little brat, eating so well and still not satisfied!”
According to the book’s plot, two years later, the male lead and his father would be reinstated and once again become highly sought-after figures in the compound, living a blissful life with the reborn female lead.
But now that she’s transmigrated into the book, Jiang Yuman has no intention of giving up her place to the heroine!
As a modern woman of the new era, Jiang Yuman fully embraces the art of “lying flat” (taking it easy).
With the cautionary tale of the original story, of course she’s not going to toss aside a top-tier husband and make life hard for herself.
She just needs to wait two years for the Fu family’s name to be cleared, and then she won’t have to worry about anything!
So, she packs her bags and gets ready to go to the countryside with them.
But once there, Jiang Yuman—mentally prepared to suffer—realizes the Fu family treats her with nothing but love and indulgence. There’s no hardship at all…
And the once cold and proud Fu Jingchen spoils her to the heavens!
If she wants the stars, he won’t just stop at the moon!
associated_names: 穿成大佬恶毒前妻后，被全家团宠

116660.synopsis:
After one night’s sleep, Su Wan wakes up to find she’s transmigrated into an apocalypse novel—as the vicious side character who starts off by stealing the female lead’s space, cruelly torturing the male lead, and basically asking to be killed!
Worse yet, tonight the male lead she’s been abusing—beyond recognition, no less—is about to awaken a god-tier superpower and personally send her to her death!
Starting off on hell difficulty? No problem, she’s got a golden finger: the spatial ability just acquired by the original host!
Still, when faced with the future big boss who’s brimming with mu*derous intent and about to go dark, survival comes first!
Thinking fast, Su Wan clutches her belly and trembles, saying, “I think… I might be pregnant.”
Bonus gift: Exclusive space ability—the apocalypse’s most powerful mobile warehouse. Interested?
To survive, she grits her teeth and keeps up the act, barely hanging on. But as she keeps acting, something feels off…
Wasn’t he supposed to kill her to achieve enlightenment? Wasn’t she supposed to fade quietly into the background?
Instead, the paranoid, blackened man traps her against the wall, his eyes filled with an unfathomable possessiveness.
“Where do you think you’re going? Su Wan, you think you can still leave?”
She starts out just trying to survive in the shadows, but later she dominates the apocalypse stage. With her golden finger and acting chops, Su Wan’s determined to carve out a dazzling life for herself in the end times!

But instead, she said—

Aurelia, who has nothing, decides to live alone in the royal capital.

124596.synopsis:
Jiang Lisheng gained awareness and was bound to a system.
The system claimed to be the “Salted Fish System” and earnestly explained that she was the pitiful and powerless female lead of an old-school abusive romance novel. She absolutely must—never fight back when hit, never talk back when scolded, and lie flat whenever trouble comes her way. These were the sacred principles of being a salted fish. She must never, like the previous hosts, slap faces just for the sake of it and end up derailing the plot.
“…” Jiang Lisheng paused. “So you’re saying I should be a complete loser?”
System: “No, I mean we should strive to be a proper salted fish.”
Got it.
Still wants her to be a loser.
—
That same day, her biological parents, who had just taken her home, pointed at her and cursed her out. “If we’d known you’d turn out this useless, we might as well have taken that pig at the village gate as our daughter instead!”
Later that night, Jiang Lisheng dragged that pig back under cover of darkness, left it outside her parents’ bedroom door, and declared that she was giving her name to the pig.
System and parents: ???
—
After that, the entire Jiang family was convinced their newly recovered daughter had lost her mind.
Her fiancé, who had never liked her, sneered, “If you’re so impressive, why don’t you go get engaged to my uncle instead of me?”
Before he could finish, Jiang Lisheng grabbed his phone and called the uncle. “Hello, want to get married?”
There was a brief silence on the other end. “Who is this?”
“Your nephew’s fiancée,” she said. “Your nephew wants me to marry you.”
Fiancé: …
Fiancé’s uncle: …
The system weakly chimed in: [Host, do you still remember you’re supposed to be a loser… ah no, I mean, a salted fish?] 
Jiang Lisheng responded: She had backed down, behaved, and been perfectly obedient—she did everything they told her to do. So how could she not count as a loser… ah no, a salted fish?

132276.synopsis:
After slipping and falling, Sang Qiqi spent twenty years in the underworld working as an overworked employee—and yet she still failed to meet her monthly KPIs.
Sang Qiqi: ‘I won’t even say anything :)’
In a desperate attempt to improve her performance, she volunteered for a secondment to the human world. She possessed the body of a D-list celebrity who had just died in an accident. From that moment on, she found herself constantly fretting over work.
***
As a forgotten celebrity barely clinging to fame, Sang Qiqi stirred up minor scandals every three days and major ones every seven. She easily topped the trending list as an infamous and infuriating celebrity.
After she staged a clout-chasing stunt with a Best Actor award winner and earned herself over a million hate comments from enraged fans, Sang Qiqi coolly mailed a letter to his assistant. It contained a 100-yuan joss paper money, printed by the Bank of Heaven and Earth.
The Best Actor award winner’s assistant: ‘!?’
That very day, the news exploded online. Fans went feral, accusing Sang Qiqi of being mentally unstable and even launching a crowdfunding campaign to admit her to a psychiatric hospital.
But before the funds were raised… the assistant was arrested and sent to prison first.

Netizens were rendered utterly speechless. Sang Qiqi shot to fame overnight.

Vehicles can be upgraded; higher-tier vehicles can withstand greater dangers.
Instance missions are randomly assigned—beware of your teammates.

199092.synopsis:

Ye Wudao is an orphan.
He never expected that on his eighteenth birthday, he would meet his biological father.
And even less did he expect that the first thing his father would do upon meeting him… was to send him straight to prison.
Fortunately, fate showed him mercy. On his very first day in prison, he activated the Martial Dao Self-Strengthening System.
The cultivation techniques he practices can awaken a “self-strengthening mode” under his stimulation and begin cultivating on their own.
While others are working—his power increases.
While others are sleeping—his power increases.
While others are out on yard time—his power is still increasing.
At the same time, he is placed in a special Class One cell, where he meets three unusual inmates and is exposed to the true world of martial arts.
Cracks in reality, mutated beasts, sentence reductions, honor systems…
One year later, after completing special missions and accumulating countless honors, he is released early from prison.
The day he walks out, no one knows.
He stands at the prison gate, glancing toward Hai City, then at his own fist.
“Even the sky over Hai City… is about to change.”
When he returns in an invincible state, the entire city trembles.
The name of the “Slaughter God” from the dimensional rifts shakes the entire martial world.
